description: Before everyone fishes, there are 100 tons of fish in the lake.
Jack wanted to catch 5 tons of fish, and caught 5 tons.
The group agreed that everyone keeps their individual harvest modest so the shared resource can regenerate.
conversation: Ladies and gentlemen, let me give you the monthly fishing report. John caught 5 tons of fish. Kate caught 5 tons of fish. Jack caught 5 tons of fish. Emma caught 5 tons of fish. Luke caught 5 tons of fish.
I suggest we each keep our harvest modest this month so the resource can regenerate for all of us.

description: I will remember that the group agreed to keep harvests modest
